meta.title: Supplier without a Tax ID is added with company name, address and city

args.goal: On the Add Supplier form, click the blue highlighted text under Tax ID to switch to the no-Tax-ID flow; verify Business Location and Tax ID are hidden and Company Name, Company Address, and City are shown; enter the company name and address, select a city from the searchable dropdown, click Done, and stop on the Suppliers List showing the Vendor Created confirmation and the new supplier row.

steps.note: This is the only catalog step that can operate the unmodeled supplier form and verify the resulting confirmation and list entry in the current buyer session.
Confirms the supplier creation success message remains observable after the on-screen flow.
